question: After truth-free authorization, what unchanged ranking and margin occur on only the fixed next-frame action view?

predecessor.single_change: Open only the already authorized FDV_action_query image and run the unchanged scorer with the same three frozen references.

proposal.selection: Union unchanged full-frame proposals with fixed 40-percent corner-tile proposals; no query truth access.

tiling.merge: Retain up to 16 full-frame and 8 per tile, remap to full-image coordinates, then score without NMS or truth filtering.

descriptor.feature: Final-layer foreground mean chooses among the same three target references; normalized foreground patches from zero-based DINOv2 block 18 supply the unchanged local score.

appearance.score: For the final-layer-selected target reference, average each query patch maximum cosine to reference foreground patches; fuse equally with final-layer target-memory score.

masker.contract: Apply unchanged native SAM2 to every retained proposal; truth evaluates ranking only after all scores are fixed.

evaluation.truth_role: Truth enters only after the complete authorized action-view ranking is fixed.

literature_motivation.source: PInVerify: An Offline Embodied Benchmark for Active Instance Verification
literature_motivation.use: Run only the score-authorized deterministic local action.

literature_motivation.source: Active Perception for Ambiguous Objects Classification
literature_motivation.use: Judge whether the authorized view separates the competing ranking.

forbidden_after_freeze: change references, action image, models, proposals, masks, features, fusion or IoU gate
add another action or use target truth to choose a view
claim the action scorer itself as a final confirmation result
literature_motivation.claim_boundary: This materializes one score-authorized action-view ranking on a fresh same-provider family. Final tiered gates remain separate; no provider transfer, deployable selector, exact-instance binding, portal ownership, affordance, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety follows.
